# Review follow-up for logos eject (PRRT_kwDOVOeymc6vU0Cj).
#
# Case 2 (PRRT_kwDOVOeymc6vU0Cj): Excluded platform-specific (Windows) and
# custom-tagged .lgo files using real loGo/s syntax (?, defer?, errdefer) must
# be lowered to valid Go sources during host eject. The ejected output must
# build and run natively on the host, cross-build for Windows without executing
# foreign binaries, and build with the custom tag under plain Go.
#
# The support-import scenario (PRRT_kwDOVOeymc6vU0Cb) lives in
# logos_eject_review_complete.txt.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Case 2: Excluded platform-specific and custom-tagged .lgo with real loGo/s syntax
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cd plat_variants

# Matched native build controls before eject:
# Host execution
logos run .
stdout '^host-ok:linux-plat:notag-ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/plat-want.txt

# Cross-compilation and custom-tag build controls with logos on host
env GOOS=windows
logos build ./...
env GOOS=$TESTGO_GOHOSTOS

logos build -tags customtag ./...

# Eject on host: excluded variants must be lowered to .go files
logos eject -o out

# Ejected tree builds and runs natively under plain Go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/plat-want.txt

# Cross-build Go output for Windows (requires lowered plat_windows.go; no native execution of foreign binary)
env GOOS=windows
go build ./...
env GOOS=$TESTGO_GOHOSTOS

# Build with custom build tag under plain Go (requires lowered plat_custom.go)
go build -tags customtag ./...
cd ../..

-- plat_variants/go.mod --
module example.com/plat

go 1.27

-- plat_variants/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func step(s string) (string, error) {
	return s, nil
}

func run() error {
	prefix := step("host-ok")?
	plat := PlatformName()?
	tag := CustomTagMsg()?
	fmt.Println(prefix + ":" + plat + ":" + tag)
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

-- plat_variants/plat_linux.lgo --
//go:build linux

package main

func parsePlatform(s string) (string, error) {
	return s, nil
}

func PlatformName() (string, error) {
	name := parsePlatform("linux-plat")?
	return name, nil
}

-- plat_variants/plat_windows.lgo --
//go:build windows

package main

func parsePlatform(s string) (string, error) {
	return s, nil
}

func PlatformName() (string, error) {
	name := parsePlatform("windows-plat")?
	return name, nil
}

-- plat_variants/plat_notag.lgo --
//go:build !customtag

package main

func parseTag(s string) (string, error) {
	return s, nil
}

func CustomTagMsg() (string, error) {
	tag := parseTag("notag-ok")?
	return tag, nil
}

-- plat_variants/plat_custom.lgo --
//go:build customtag

package main

func parseTag(s string) (string, error) {
	return s, nil
}

func CustomTagMsg() (string, error) {
	tag := parseTag("custom-ok")?
	return tag, nil
}

-- plat_variants/plat_ignore.lgo --
//go:build ignore

package main

func IgnoredVariant() string {
	return "ignored"
}
